displayName: GHADV-2238: Apache DolphinScheduler: Incorrect Authorization vulnerability allows users to access workflow instance information belo
description:
Apache DolphinScheduler: Incorrect Authorization vulnerability allows users to access workflow instance information belonging to projects they do not have permission to access. 

⚠️ NEEDS-REWRITE: Query is generic SQL, needs conversion to Cloud Guard detector condition

dataSourceDetails.query: SELECT "siem_auth_bypass_ghadv_2238", "data__json.rEventName" FROM "oci_monitoring_metricexplorer_metrics" WHERE "compartmentId" = '$COMPARTMENT_ID' AND "namespace" = 'AuditEvents' AND "data__json.rEventName" LIKE '%apache%' AND "value" > 0
